
include_once comm_platform_COMMAND_VEHICLE.txt
include_once comm_platform_MISSION_UAV.txt
include_once comm_platform_JAMMER.txt
include_once comm_platform_REAR.txt
include_once comm_platform_SAT.txt
include_once comm_platform_INS.txt
include_once observers.txt

//-----------界面配置的仿真时间来设置
start_date sep 15 2025  //仿真开始日期
start_time 00:00:00   //开始时间
end_time 90 min //结束时间
realtime        //实时模式和非实时模式non-realtime
clock_rate 2.0  //仿真速率,真实世界1S，仿真2秒
multi_thread

simulation_name "MultiMethod_UAV_Comm_Scenario"

event_pipe
   file output\scenario_events.aer
end_event_pipe

// ============================================================
// 场景事件输出配置（CSV日志）
// ============================================================
csv_event_output
  file output\scenario_events.csv
  // 标准AFSIM事件
  enable PLATFORM_ADDED
  enable PLATFORM_INITIALIZED
  enable MESSAGE_TRANSMITTED    // SendMessage 发送事件 ✓
  enable MESSAGE_RECEIVED      // 消息到达接收方事件 ✓
  enable JAMMING_REQUEST_INITIATED
  enable JAMMING_REQUEST_CANCELED
  enable JAMMING_REQUEST_UPDATED
  enable WEAPON_FIRED
  enable SENSOR_DETECTION_CHANGED

  enable WEAPON_TURNED_ON
  enable WEAPON_MODE_ACTIVATED
  enable WEAPON_MODE_DEACTIVATED

  enable PLATFORM_ADDED
  enable PLATFORM_INITIALIZED
  enable PLATFORM_DELETED
  enable PLATFORM_BROKEN
  enable PLATFORM_OMITTED

  #enable PLATFORM_POSITION
  enable SIMULATION_STARTING
  enable SIMULATION_COMPLETE

  enable LINK_ADDED_TO_MANAGER
  enable LINK_ENABLED_ON_MANAGER
  enable LINK_DISABLED_ON_MANAGER
  enable LINK_REMOVED_FROM_MANAGER

  enable MESSAGE_HOP

  enable COMM_TURNED_ON
  enable COMM_FREQUENCY_CHANGED

  enable LOCAL_TRACK_INITIATED
  enable LOCAL_TRACK_UPDATED
  enable LOCAL_TRACK_DROPPED
                
  enable SENSOR_TRACK_INITIATED
  enable SENSOR_TRACK_UPDATED
  enable SENSOR_TRACK_DROPPED
  
  #enable SENSOR_DETECTION_ATTEMPT
  enable EXCHANGE_COMPLETED
  
  enable LINK_ENABLED_ON_LOCAL
  enable LINK_DISABLED_ON_LOCAL

  enable MOVER_TURNED_ON
end_csv_event_output
